line: Your claude.ai connectors, as Claude Code lists them.
cliFailed: The CLI could not list its connectors
noneHint: The CLI lists none for this account. Connect Docs, Gmail or Calendar in claude.ai's connector settings and ask again.
notListedSame: They are authorised the same way.

blocked.body: Run claude in a terminal, type /mcp and sign in, or turn it on in claude.ai's connector settings. Then ask the CLI again.

ask.hint: Opens a new chat with the prompt already written. The prompt only asks Claude to read, and any permission the connector's tools need is asked for in that chat.
ask.none: No prepared prompts for this connector.

authorise.title: How to authorise a connector
authorise.waiting: Waiting for you to finish signing in…
authorise.timedOut: {{connector}} is still not connected after two minutes. Authorise it again, or ask the CLI again once you have signed in.
